title: Fix worktrees launcher and dirty detection
Improve dirty worktree removal safety
paragraphs: Show local changes before removing dirty worktrees so users can confirm data loss explicitly, and cover the detection with git-backed integration tests.

title: Fix global worktrees launcher path and ignore Electrobun build outputs
paragraphs:
- worktrees now runs index.ts from its own installed location, so it works in any git repo.
- Ignore tools/*/build/ so local Electrobun build artifacts do not pollute git status.

title: Add worktrees CLI for interactive git worktree cleanup.
paragraphs: Bun plus inquirer prompts, lists primary vs linked trees, remove selected or all linked. Windows: install.ps1 stub. macOS: launcher copy to ~/.local/bin via install-to-path.sh. Docs, header image, README table entry, and AGENTS file structure note.
